headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: On consolidated basis, topline for Q2’27 came in at ₹ 6,655 crore, up by 38% YoY, amidst OEM volume growth of ~21%+ (2-W+PV).
EBITDA in Q2FY27 came in at ₹ 733 crore with EBTDA margins at 11% (up ~70 bps QoQ).

Investment Rationale: • Strong market positioning with consistent outperformance over industry growth : Over the years, Uno Minda has established itself as a leading automotive component supplier with a diversified presence across multiple product categories, allowing it to capture a larger share of the increasing component value per vehicle.
This was evident in Q2FY27, with consolidated revenue growing 38% YoY against approximately 18% growth in overall automotive production.
valuation: Investment Rationale: • Strong market positioning with consistent outperformance over industry growth : Over the years, Uno Minda has established itself as a leading automotive component supplier with a diversified presence across multiple product categories, allowing it to capture a larger share of the increasing component value per vehicle.

Rating and Target Price • With strong underlying domestic OEM volume growth in the auto space coupled with Uno strong competitive positioning, diversified product portfolio and industry leading capex spends, we continue to have a positive view on the company.
Consequently, we maintain our BUY rating on the stock & value it at ₹ 1, 550 i.e. 4 0x P/E on FY2 9E EPS .
